usedFor: Shopify holds your orders and products, and SQL Server stores them as rows through “Insert a row”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Insert a row” in SQL Server
bestTemplate.why: Each paid order becomes a row in your own database, ready for reports outside Shopify.

watchOut: “Execute a query” runs any query on SQL Server, so test it on “Order Paid” before live data.
